coverage.note: workingfamilies.org has no Virginia state page (404) and no Virginia legislative posts in its post sitemap. The 2025 slate (8 legislative candidates plus a lieutenant governor pick, excluded) comes from press coverage only. Virginia Mercury, RVA Magazine and Blue Voter Guide were not fetchable by script (403), so the full WFP Virginia list and any 2023 slate are unverified.

National site: 2023 general guide and recap (7 names), 2025 primary post (Cole). Site search for virginia, delegate and house of delegates found nothing else in scope. Our Revolution Northern Virginia was not checked beyond a web search that found no slate.

No 2023 to 2026 Virginia governor or General Assembly endorsement found on these chapter pages. The Metro DC DSA 2026 page lists Virginia constitutional amendments only; its only Virginia House of Delegates statement is a 2021 endorsement (out of scope). Social media and image-only posts were not audited; Shenandoah Valley is an organizing committee and was not checked.

Directory cards for 2023 (26 state legislative) and 2025 (14). The 2022, 2024 and 2026 directories list Virginia local candidates only. The 2021 cohort is out of scope (those terms ended in January 2024). RFS release-only candidacies noted in earlier repo reviews were not reconciled.

gaps: Official results come from the Virginia Department of Elections historical site (historical.elections.virginia.gov). Term rule: Va. Code 24.2-215 (House of Delegates) and 24.2-214 (Senate), https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title24.2/chapter2/. Terms begin on the second Wednesday in January after the election. Term dates are computed from the rule.
